name: 45457-decode-gptoss20b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 60 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. Seed static 45457.
workload: single-turn plain text synthesised by guidellm: 260 prompt tokens and 300 output tokens, both pinned by min == max; `request_format: plain`, and no `spec.backend.sampling_params` is declared.
purpose: A single-user writing assistant generating steady 300-token replies to short prompts on one 20-billion-parameter model GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line for 45457-decode-gptoss20b-1gpu. A plain serving configuration:
# nothing here was searched for, and there is no tuned.yaml and no tunable.yaml.
#
# EVERY KEY BELOW IS SET EXPLICITLY, including ones whose value matches an engine default. Do not
# delete one as redundant -- a change of default would otherwise move the setup.

model: openai/gpt-oss-20b

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
enable-expert-parallel: false

max-num-seqs: 16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
